node.title: XR rank-two extension families obey an exact collision ledger
node.statement: For a rank-two shell, split each actual inactive extension T_i into inside reuse I_i=T_i intersect Z_i and outside part O_i=T_i\X. The pairwise block cap is exactly |I_i|+|I_j|+|O_i intersect O_j|<=z_i+z_j-d-1. Summing gives (t-1)sum|I_i|+sum_x C(m_x,2)<=(t-1)sum z_i-C(t,2)(d+1). Together with the actual external zero sets and forced extension sizes, these inequalities are a complete finite extension-family compatibility ledger. Counting support families/packings, first-core ownership, and cross-core payment remain open.
